# cpp-httplib

Single-header HTTP server library used by `ote-editor` (editor/server).

- Upstream: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib
- Pinned release tag: **v0.26.0** (`httplib.h` and `LICENSE` copied unmodified from that tag)
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Plain HTTP only: built without OpenSSL, zlib or brotli.
